rationale_overall: Watchlist at cap 3 (MSFT/NVDA AI, LMT defense). Pass-1 across every named wave found no thesis breach, peak signal, or obsolescence in the three holdings. LMT's in-window Terran Orbital acquisition bid shows the position is itself gaining space exposure, not a stale defense-only holding. RKLB generated two dated milestones (Jan 8 SDA $515M Tranche 2 award; Feb 21 Varda Winnebago-1 re-entry landing) that would support an add, but at cap=3 an add needs a remove and none of the three clears removal. Hold unchanged; RKLB a live candidate.
